summary: Chicago-based; the main US member of Star Alliance.
checkin: Online and app check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Airport check-in begins no earlier than 4 hours before departure.
baggage: Basic Economy on domestic flights includes only a personal item; other fares add a carry-on. Checked bag fees are set by the airline marketing the first flight; MileagePlus Premier members and United cardmembers check bags free.
tips: Use United's bag fee calculator (sign in or pick any flight) to see what you'll pay.
United recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic and 3 hours before international flights.
